name: Jacob Richards
bio: A Representative from Pennsylvania; born near Chester, Delaware County, Pa., in 1773; graduated from the University of Pennsylvania at Philadelphia in 1794; studied law; was admitted to the bar in 1795 and commenced practice in Philadelphia; elected as a Democratic Republican to the Eighth and to the two succeeding Congresses (March 4, 1803-March 3, 1809); was commissioned as colonel of militia in Delaware County, Pa.; engaged in the practice of law until his death near Chester, Pa., July 20, 1816.
